content_sections.heading: ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 18 vacancies are available - 9 for Junior Resident and 9 for Tutor.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Resident / Tutor: MBBS from recognized University with completed internship and registration with NMC/MCI/State Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years for all posts. Age relaxation will be as per government rules. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Junior Resident / Tutor: Rs. 1,12,054/- per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026 is 08 October 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ESIC Alwar?
faq.answer: ESIC Alwar has announced a total of 18 vacancies for the posts of Junior Resident and Tutor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident / Tutor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized university, have completed their internship, and be registered with the NMC/MCI/State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the ESIC Alwar recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident / Tutor posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,12,054/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the ESIC Alwar recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents on the specified date and venue.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC candidates. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification followed by an Oral Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ESIC Alwar Medical College & Hospital located?
faq.answer: The ESIC Medical College & Hospital is located in Alwar, Rajasthan, with the pincode 301030.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any specific format for the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are advised to check the official notification for details regarding the application form. If a form is required, it should be duly filled and brought to the interview venue.
